messages:
sec-bot: [ALERT] abnormal SSO activity detected for user m.white@acme.com — 4 failed attempts then 2 successful logins from IPs in FR and US within 9 minutes. Risk: high. IncidentID: INC-2026-0421
amal: I see it. Two different continents within 10m, probably token theft or session replay. Not normal for this user.
jordan: On it. Will revoke all active sessions and force MFA re-enroll. Running: `authctl revoke-sessions --user m.white@acme.com --all`
ops-sre: FYI executing revocation now. ETA ~20s.
ops-sre: Done — all sessions revoked, user tokens invalidated. Pushed global logout.
amal: Thanks. Can we confirm no admin API keys were used? Also check KMS decrypt logs for the auth key.
maria: Pulling audit logs. KMS key ring redwood-auth show decrypt requests at 2026-04-21T14:03:22Z by service-account: auth-refresh, originating from IP 18.204.77.11 (us-east-1). No unusual principal activity besides expected auth service.
jordan: The login IPs look like 2 different client IPs outside their usual CIDR. I searched user agent: both success events report `Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)` — generic.
amal: Could be credential stuffing + valid refresh token reuse. Since sessions were revoked, rotate refresh tokens and force password/MFA reset.
kai: I'll open a ticket to rotate refresh tokens for the user and escalate if we see reuse: https://rwd.internal/tickets/INC-2026-0421
amal: Also add a temporary rule: block new refresh tokens from countries not in the user's ACL for 24h. Can infra add a transient policy?
ops-sre: Creating a policy on the auth proxy: `policy add deny-refresh --condition geo NOT IN [US,CA,DE] --ttl 24h` — applying now.
maria: Noted. Audit note: exported full auth logs to secure bucket s3://rwd-secure/INC-2026-0421 for forensic review. Checksum: sha256: e3b0c442...
jordan: Postmortem action items: 1) Add detection rule for same-user multi-region logins within 30m, 2) Add alert for >3 concurrent sessions creation, 3) Review KMS key usage for auth-refresh service.
amal: Also recommend RBAC change: disallow service accounts from minting long-lived refresh tokens unless explicitly allowed by an admin-approved onboarding flow.
kai: I'll track RBAC change and create a PR for the policy docs. Assigning to eng-auth and eng-security.
amal: Comm plan: send a cautious user email to m.white@acme.com to confirm activity and require MFA reset. Ops to hold or redact any PII. Will draft copy.
ops-sre: Draft ready, requesting legal review before sending.
maria: Closing monitoring loop: set a 48h heightened watch on auth anomalies, and add scheduled KMS key audit for next week.
jordan: Good. If anything else pops up I'll reopen INC-2026-0421. :thumbsup:
amal: Thanks everyone. We'll do a short retro tomorrow 10:00 to finalize actions.
